authorization: Owner requested research on all currently collected human games and differences from model play
scope: Read-only observational D1 census; no human training, no full-information scoring or counterfactual continuations

snapshot.source: Shared private D1 export for this site and Clint; present game rows all Clint

primary: 029 same-public-observation action comparison on unflagged human decisions, assistance status unknown when absent
filters: Exclude test, bot, timeout and assisted=true from primary. Report assistance groups separately, no override. Exclude single-plan/automatic-finishing choices from decision-opportunity comparisons.
metrics: Pass rate where a legal reply exists
Overtaking partner where legal reply exists
Bomb choice where legal bomb exists
inference: CPU single-thread; own hand/public history/counts only; all other hidden cards and final result excluded from network inputs
uncertainty: 2000 whole-match bootstrap replicates seed2026111507; 12 sessions are not 12 authenticated independent people; descriptive, no causal strength claim
privacy: No names, rooms, raw hands, trajectories, keys or raw match IDs in public summaries; raw snapshot and per-action diagnostics stay ignored
existingRunProtection: No changes to active frozen reason training/evaluation, models, cutoff or webpage default
